🏆 SAAD VMS — Real-Time Smart Visitor Management System
MCA Capstone · IE402
Spring Boot 3.2MySQL 8 React 18JWT WebSocket/STOMPZXing QR JavaMailSenderJUnit 5

Full-stack enterprise visitor management platform with three role-based user types (Admin, Security Officer, Visitor). Deployed live on Railway + Vercel.

  • QR Code email delivery pipeline — ZXing generates QR → JavaMailSender sends HTML email → Security validates token, blacklist, expiry, and single-use status at gate
  • JWT Role-Based Auth — access token (15 min) + refresh token (7 days), BCrypt strength 12, Bucket4j rate limiting (10 req/min per IP)

  • 71 test cases (Unit, Integration, System, UAT, Security, Performance) — 100% pass rate
Live: Deployed on Railway (Spring Boot + MySQL) + Vercel (React) · GitHub: github.com/sameer89900/saad-visitor-management-system
📚 Student Result Management System
Core Java + MySQL
Core JavaMySQL 8 JDBCOOP CollectionsStored ProceduresFile I/O

Full-featured console application to manage student academic records, calculate grades, generate marksheets, and produce result reports — backed by MySQL for persistent storage.

  • Student CRUD: Add, update, delete and search students using Java Collections (HashMap, ArrayList) with JDBC persistence to MySQL
  • Subject & Marks Management: Multi-subject mark entry per student, auto-calculate total, percentage, and letter grade (A+/A/B/C/D/F)
  • Stored Procedures: MySQL stored procedures for batch grade calculation, top-performer queries, and pass/fail statistics using GROUP BY, HAVING
  • Result Reports: Generate formatted marksheet reports per student and class-wise rank lists using File I/O (FileWriter, BufferedWriter)
  • Exception Handling: Custom exceptions for duplicate roll numbers, invalid marks, and DB connection failures with proper try-catch-finally blocks
  • Transactions: JDBC transactions (commit/rollback) ensuring data integrity when updating multiple subject marks simultaneously
Key Concepts: OOP design (Student, Subject, Result classes), JDBC PreparedStatements, SQL JOINs, Stored Procedures, File I/O, Exception Handling
📖 Library Management System
Core Java + MySQL
Core JavaMySQL 8 JDBCOOP CollectionsStored ProceduresMultithreading

Robust library management console application handling books, members, and borrow/return workflows with fine calculation, overdue alerts, and complete MySQL-backed persistence.

  • Book Inventory: Add, update, remove and search books by title/author/ISBN using JDBC PreparedStatements; inventory count managed via MySQL triggers on borrow/return
  • Member Management: Register/deactivate library members, track active borrowings per member with Collections (LinkedList for borrow queue)
  • Borrow & Return System: Issue books with due-date tracking, auto-calculate overdue fines (₹2/day), update book availability using JDBC transactions
  • Stored Procedures: MySQL procedures for monthly borrowing reports, most-borrowed books ranking, overdue member lists with JOINs across Book, Member, BorrowRecord tables
  • OOP Design: Inheritance hierarchy — LibraryItem → Book/Magazine; Interface-based design (Borrowable, Searchable) for extensibility
  • Exception Handling: Custom exceptions — BookNotAvailableException, MaxBooksExceededException, MemberNotFoundException — with detailed error messages
Key Concepts: Inheritance, Interfaces, JDBC Transactions, MySQL Triggers & Procedures, Collections (LinkedList, HashMap), Custom Exceptions
